title: Metadata Integrity Audit

p1e056_metadata.transition_note: §9.2 lists only 'In Audit → Certified' as the path to Certified. Archived → Certified is not a listed transition. Item must follow: Archived → In Audit → Certified. However, this item was previously Certified (certification_date: 2026-07-22, certification_batch: 'Section E Block 1') and was mistakenly archived per DL-033 finding — this is a restoration, not a new certification.

difficulty_score.issue: DifficultyScore=1 maps to 'Easy', but content-block Difficulty='Moderate-Easy' maps to DifficultyScore=2. Dual-block inconsistency.

dl016_topic_mismatch.detail: Metadata-block ExplanationWrongA describes physical inventory control ('Operational knowledge does not eliminate the segregation risk created when the custodian counts without oversight') — this is inventory/custodian topic text, NOT user access recertification. Content-block stem is about 'Beacon finds employees retain access after changing departments.' This is a cross-item contamination (DL-016).

blocking_issues: ExplanationWrongA is topically unrelated to the learner-facing choices (DL-016 topic mismatch per §9.4.1)
Metadata-block CorrectChoice implied = B (EW_B empty), content-block CorrectChoice = D (dual-block CC mismatch per §9.4.2)
Archived → Certified is not a listed transition in §9.2

sample_issues.dual_block_difficulty_inconsistency: P1-FC-025: metadata DifficultyScore=1 (Easy) vs content Difficulty='Moderate'
sample_issues.dl026_empty_non_cc_slots: P1-FC-001 and P1-FC-025 both have empty non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots (DL-026 pattern)

section_f_archives.uniform_difficulty_pattern: Template-assigned; varies across items but dual-block inconsistencies present
section_f_archives.no_metadata_loss: Confirmed per §9.2 Rule 3: 'Archival preserves content. Archived questions retain full question text and metadata. Only the state field changes.'

unprocessed_to_archived.applies_to: 75 Pack C Section F + 36 Pack D Section F = 111 items
unprocessed_to_archived.note: These items have no question_state field or are 'Unprocessed'. Transition is clean.

archived_to_certified.rule: §9.2 lists no path from Archived to Certified. The only path to Certified is In Audit → Certified.
archived_to_certified.restoration_context: P1-E-056 was previously Certified (2026-07-22) and mistakenly archived per DL-033 finding. The proposed 'recertification' is semantically a restoration of mistaken archival, not a new certification. However, §9.2 does not define a 'restore' transition. Minimum path: Archived → Unprocessed → In Audit → Certified, OR a documented exception in REVISION_HISTORY.md treating the archival as void and restoring the prior Certified state.
archived_to_certified.recommendation: Either (a) restore to Certified with a documented REVISION_HISTORY.md entry noting mistaken archival rectification and re-verify all 6 CAQS dimensions at HIGH confidence, OR (b) route through In Audit → Certified per §9.2 strict reading.

verdict: ISSUES FOUND — P1-E-056 NOT metadata-ready for recertification; Section F archives are metadata-safe
